body.name: Regular multinomial profile band
body.construction: Set \(\mathcal A_n=\{\vartheta:\vartheta\geq0,\ \sum_{x,z,y}\vartheta_{xzy}=1,\ \|\vartheta-\widehat\theta\|_\infty\leq r_n\}\), \(\mathcal A_n^{\mathrm{reg}}=\mathcal A_n\cap\Theta_{\mathrm{reg}}(\delta)\), \(L_{\mathrm{reg}}(\delta)=\sup\{|C_{P'}(t)-C_{P''}(t)|/\|\theta(P')-\theta(P'')\|_\infty:t\in\mathcal T_0,\ \theta(P'),\theta(P'')\in\Theta_{\mathrm{reg}}(\delta),\ P'\neq P''\}\), \(\underline C_n(t)=\inf_{P':\theta(P')\in\mathcal A_n^{\mathrm{reg}}}C_{P'}(t)\), and \(\overline C_n(t)=\sup_{P':\theta(P')\in\mathcal A_n^{\mathrm{reg}}}C_{P'}(t)\).
